objective: Compare acquisition performance for one created-at cohort across multiple fixed observation windows while resolving the cohort and raw evidence only once.

semantics.windowValidation: each windowDays value uses the canonical INS-004O positive-safe-integer validator
semantics.windowOrder: deduplicate requested windowDays preserving first occurrence order
semantics.maturity: evaluated independently for each requested window

composition.windowValidation: reuse canonical INS-004O window-day validator before persistence access
composition.cohort: exactly one canonical CRM listCreatedAtRange read
composition.rawEvidence: exactly one INS-004L getEvidence call for the complete created-at cohort
composition.perWindowEvidence: reuse the same in-memory raw evidence and apply canonical INS-004O/P evidence semantics independently per window
composition.perWindowEconomics: build attributed economics entirely in memory for that window's mature relationships
composition.perWindowPerformance: reuse canonical INS-004J combined economics, durable outcome, exact outcome-rate, and cost-per-outcome projection

rules: At least one observation window is required.
Requested windows are validated and deduplicated before any persistence access.
Requested dimensions are validated and deduplicated before any persistence access.
Window order in the result follows first occurrence order from the request.
The CRM created-at cohort is resolved exactly once.
Raw evidence is loaded exactly once for the complete created-at cohort.
No persistence access occurs inside the per-window loop.
Each window independently computes its mature relationship denominator.
Different windows may therefore have different matureRelationshipCount and immatureRelationshipCount values.
The same raw presentation and fact objects are reused in memory across all windows.
Current presentation metadata is restricted to the mature relationship identities for each window but is not historically reconstructed.
Dimension outcome buckets already expose exact quoteRate and bindRate fractions; no new rate projection is introduced.
No floating-point percentage calculation is introduced.
No new SQL, schema, persistence mutation, duplicate evidence read, dashboard UI, deployment, or telephony activation is introduced.
